subject: Cutover bridging and approval ask — acceptance window impact
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@stellarhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellarhealth.com
Date: 2027-07-01T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and cutover window — procurement hold

Neha / Neha's team,

Quick note from procurement: they need an updated SOC2 evidence package and procurement needs 2 extra weeks to complete vendor onboarding. That pushes our internal acceptance window out — team was targeting the week of 7/12 for final validation, looks like earliest now is 7/26.

We still want to keep the cutover in Q3 but this creates a squeeze on the final-mile testing. Can you advise whether Redwood can provide a short-term acceptance lane (dedicated capacity + extended trial credits) to keep our pilot timeline intact? Alternatively, if we rebaseline the MAP, what are the minimal gating items we must keep to avoid a full cutover slip?

Attached: procurement note (pdf).

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Stellar Health

---
Stellar Procurement Email: procurement@stellarhealth.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and cutover window — procurement hold

Amy — thanks for the heads up. Putting a quick proposal and options below so we can close this out fast: 

Options we can do this week:
- Option A (bridge lane): Provide dedicated 2-node pool for 2 weeks + 10% account credit to cover validation tokens. Keeps your acceptance window on 7/12; limited to pilot traffic profile.
- Option B (soft rebaseline): Move final validation to week of 7/26, keep all gating tests identical, extend MAP milestone dates; no credits.
- Option C (hybrid): Start phased cutover for non-PHI workloads on 7/12 and stagger PHI workload after procurement completes.

I can put Option A in writing and route for approval if you want a commercial uplift. Please tell me which path you prefer and I will escalate internally.

Attaching an updated MAP (v2) that marks the gating tests and minimal acceptance checklist.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-02T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft and cutover window — procurement hold

Team — forwarding Amy's procurement note. Stellar asks for a 2-week onboarding delay unless we can offer a short bridge lane. Quick asks:
1) Can Dedicated provide a transient 2-node pool for two weeks starting 7/12?
2) If yes, what is the commercial (credits / manual override) to cover costs?
3) Any security/soc2 gating we need to expedite? Procurement referenced SOC2 evidence doc (attached).

I propose: temp pool + 10% credit to reduce friction; if we cannot do the pool, we rebaseline MAP to 7/26 and shift canary plan. Need decision by 07/03 EOD to avoid downstream resource conflicts.

Forwarded message included below for context.

--Neha
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-03T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft and cutover window — procurement hold

Neha — I recommend we approve the bridge lane. Rationale: this is a strategic pilot with clear expansion potential; losing momentum here increases churn risk and timeline drift. Suggested commercial: 2-node pool for 2 weeks (no SLA credit), and a one-time 12% debit on next invoice (applied as credit) to limit their sticker shock. I can patch the approval and bill as one-off credit. 

Karthik — can infra schedule a transient pool for 7/12 to 7/26 and confirm ops guardrails (rate limits, KV cache isolation)?

Laura — if you sign off, I'll prepare the Approval_Summary.pdf and route to finance for quick zero-touch billing change.

Jonas
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-03T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft and cutover window — procurement hold

We can provision a transient dedicated pool for the requested dates. Notes/constraints:
- Pool will be limited to the pilot model variant and capped at the traffic envelope the MAP defines (we'll enforce quotas).
- SOC2 evidence request: infra will provide an expedited evidence bundle (see SOC2-evidence-request.pdf attached) but we cannot accelerate third-party attestations.
- Ops runbook will include a rollback trigger if prefix/KV conflicts are observed.

I'll schedule the infra change and send the runbook to Neha and customer. From infra side, this is doable but must be approved by finance for the credit/discount.

-Karthik
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-07-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: transient pool + credit — Stellar pilot

Amy / Team — we will stand up the transient dedicated pool for 7/12–7/26 limited to the pilot model and traffic envelope. Redwood will apply a one-time 12% credit on the next invoice to help cover validation costs.

Action items and owners: 
- Karthik: provision pool and send ops runbook to Stellar by 07/08 EOD (infra contact: infra@redwood.ai).
- Neha: update MAP v2 to reflect the bridge lane and revised milestones; include acceptance checklist (minimal gating items) and send signed copy to procurement.
- Finance: prepare credit (Jonas will loop finance) and confirm billing change by 07/10.

Amy — we want to protect your acceptance window while keeping the overall cutover momentum. If procurement still requires additional evidence after our package, we'll coordinate a rolling acceptance for non-PHI traffic as discussed.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
